api.admit: admit(&mut SequentialSource, &AtomicBool) -> Result<SourceAdmission, Fault>. Use complete native source visits and the same held File, never a caller-made Unit, range, path or success boolean. SourceAdmission has private fields and constructor, no Clone/Deserialize/test bypass. Finalizer prepare requires &SourceAdmission and calls check_span(&UnitSpan) before consuming each span.
api.binding: Store exact SpoolIdentity, ClockDescriptor, both TrackExtent lengths/hashes, receipts, PrefixState/seal cause/incomplete/torn/uncommitted flags. Collect constant-space native unit counts and domain-separated ordered range/configuration/clock digests for both tracks; require same parsed configuration, exact ordinal/byte and same-track clock continuity. check_span obtains facts from a live native UnitSpan, calls its guards and compares exact whole-source binding and admitted per-track configuration/bounds; it does not turn copied SpanFacts into authority. The full committed raw hashes bind all admitted unit observations without retaining an unbounded per-unit table. Source flags remain attached and are not upgraded to a normally finished recording.
api.lifetime: Each span inspection is provisional until the entire SequentialSource visit succeeds. One cursor user only; save/restore even on error, no reopen/clone or detached worker. Cancellation/read/seek/structural failure is terminal and cannot produce SourceAdmission. Finishing both visits and final guard checks precedes construction. This proof covers the defined header subset, not packet/remux/decode/publication or chat completeness.

payloadInspection.seam: Reuse native block's structurally computed encoded start/end after its track/timecode/flags header. BlockGroup invokes inspection only after its full BlockDuration/ReferenceBlock validation, so RAP meaning is final. An opt-in typed observer receives exact payload bounds, native Configuration and container RAP. Ordinary index scans do not inspect VP9 bytes or reject previously structurally valid payloads. One-unit rescan is bounded to the native span and must reproduce its exact facts; no scanning for magic bytes, copying complete blocks, or accepting bytes outside that span.
payloadInspection.superframe: Read at most34 tail bytes. A final0xc0-mask marker requires both index markers,1..8 nonzero little-endian lengths with1..4-byte magnitude and checked sum exactly equal to payload minus index. Otherwise the payload is one frame. Inspect every declared subframe in order, not only first. No padding/index repair or guessed split. Each subframe prefix read is at most32bytes; missing required bits is failure, never zero-filled. Prefix stage stops after render-size syntax, so compressed entropy/tile data remains for the separate full decoder.
payloadInspection.subset: First coded subframe of the retained video must be a genuine VP9 key frame and its container must be RAP; show_existing/inter/intra-only cannot substitute. Every subframe must have valid frame marker and profile0; profile0 implies8bit4:2:0. Keys must have sync0x498342, BT.709 studio-range color (matching current codec_facts), native width/height and render size equal to coded dimensions. Reserved/unknown color/profile or changed coded/render dimensions are Unsupported, never coerced. Later inter headers parse show_frame/error_resilient/intra_only/reset_context/refresh flags, three reference indices/sign bits and frame_size_with_refs or explicit size, then render size. Maintain only eight bounded reference descriptors; first key resets them. Apply each subframe's refresh flags to a fixed working copy before parsing the next subframe, then commit state only after the complete packet validates. show_existing requires a previously admitted reference and compatible profile. Profile0 intra-only has normative BT.601 studio defaults, so it is explicitly unsupported in this initial BT.709 subset rather than silently inheriting prior color. No arithmetic decoder, probability tables or picture buffers.
payloadInspection.presentation: Invisible frames and supported superframes are allowed; they remain one original container packet. Counts are observations, not invented PTS/DTS. State persists across compatible repeated initialization units, with exact native config continuity, but every new source admission starts empty and requires a true key. A later independently signaled key must also match the fixed subset. Full final-file decode and every-packet payload/side/timing equality remain mandatory to establish compressed syntax and presentation preservation.
